Definition: perhaps akin to the base of G1404 (through the idea of capturing); to grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap:--take.
BiblicalUsage: To catch, to take hold of, as Paul quotes Job to say God takes the wise in their own craftiness, catching them in the very trap they set.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's wisdom catches the crafty in their own craft, and the trap I set for others is the one I fall into myself.
